gap: The per-fetch record (DataReference, built from FetchDigest) carries source identity, origin, category, locator, retrieved_at, sha256, byte length, period, symbols, schema shape, cost and availability, but none of: version/etag (no etag handling exists anywhere in backend/crates), cursor (the connector Checkpoint is a separate per-source KV record, not on the reference), entitlement (licensing lives on the admission and the per-source SourceManifest), geography (per-source SourceManifest.region only), freshness/expiry, or re-fetch instructions beyond the opaque locator.
